translation.name: Nasoruan siGot len nasoruan ta Uluveu

content: AJon Baptais eutaut hǝn nap̃isal
Egai natub̃atan hǝn na-kel-uri-an tovoi husur aYesu Kristo tovi Natun aGot.
Ehum ahai kelkel ur sua, aIsaiah totos gat nǝsa aGot tokel mai aNatun. Ike,

content.text: Nadoldol sua satokai len naut masmas tob̃ǝb̃esw ke,

content: Imagenan, aJon evisi, itoh len naut masmas tob̃ǝb̃esw, ikel uri ke, nǝvanuan gail limasbaptais hǝn b̃imasil ke lotopair dan nǝsaan salito van hǝn aGot hǝn b̃erub̃at nǝsaan salit gail.
Nǝvanuan naut a Jerusalem mai naprovens Jutea kavkav luvan hǝn lǝb̃esǝsǝloŋ hǝni. Ale nǝboŋ lotokel vǝhot nǝsaan salit gail, ibaptais hǝn galito len Nawisel Jortan.
Nahurabat siJon, luvaii hǝn navurun nǝkamel, ale nǝhau tutuṽ evi nahurhub̃uluk. Ihanhan nalokust, ihanhan nǝhani nasukapak toum hǝni.
AJon ikel uri ke, “Avan sua dereh tegǝm a tahw len ginau, gai idaŋ sǝhor ginau, ale ginau nǝsanor kasi hǝn nǝb̃etǝŋadur, sah rub̃at nǝhau hǝn naributbut san.
Ginau nubaptais hǝn gamito hǝn nǝwai, be dereh gai tibaptais hǝn gamito hǝn aNunun aGot.”
Nǝbaptaisan siYesu
Len nǝboŋ sua, aYesu iyar len naut a Nasaret a Kalili gǝmai ale aJon ibaptais hǝni len Nawisel Jortan.
Nǝboŋ aYesu tomadhale mǝhat dan nǝwai enan, eris aGot totar p̃ul nǝmav hǝn tosǝŋav ale eris aNunun togǝm vi pan vi lan, sum̃an nǝtav.
Beti esǝsǝloŋ hǝn nadoldol togǝm len nǝmav toke, “Gaiug govi anatugw ulum̃an sagw notolǝmas bun gaiug, nohǝhaṽur masuṽ hǝn gaiug.”
ASetan italtal sob̃uer hǝn aYesu hǝn b̃igol b̃isa
Vǝha-sua ŋai aNunun aGot esǝhar aYesu vi lan naut masmas tob̃ǝb̃esw.
Itoh ei len nǝmariboŋ tovi 40 ale aSetan italtal sob̃uer ke tigol nǝsaan. Itoh mai narivatvat nalilihai lotolǝboi lǝb̃isah pǝpasi ale aŋel gail lovi tarhǝt san.
Ahai susur metǝkav gail
Husur nǝboŋ galenan, aenemi siJon lutah gati, riŋi len naim bǝbaŋis. Beti aYesu evi Kalili, ikel ur na-kel-uri-an siGot.
Ike, “Namityal egǝm tia, natohan pipihabǝlan aGot egǝm pǝpadaŋ. Mitipair dan nǝsaan samito, dǝlom na-kel-uri-an tovoi enan!”
Boŋ sua aYesu toyaryar bitas tarhǝt Nab̃iltiwai Kalili, eris alarmiṽan, aSimon mai aAdru artobar hǝn nalevlev len nab̃iltiwai husur arovi vanuan nǝsahiehan.
Ale aYesu ikel mai gǝlaru ke, “Mǝregǝmai! Mǝrehusur ginau ale nigol mǝregǝm vi vanuan nǝ-sah-hǝn-nǝvanuan-an!”
Vǝha-sua ŋai aroriŋ nalevlev sǝlar gail, arohusuri.
Nǝboŋ aYesu toyar kǝkereh am husur bitas, eris aJemes mai aJon alarmiṽan, anatun aSepeti gǝlaru. Arusah len nab̃ot salito, arobutan nalevlev salit gail lunor.
Vǝha-sua ŋai ekis gǝlaru hǝn arb̃itah maii, ale aroriŋ atǝmalaru len nab̃ot mai nǝvanuan nauman gail, ale arutah maii, arohusuri.
AYesu ehut nanunun sua tosa
AYesu mai ahai susur san gail lovi lan navile a Kapernaum, ale len nǝSappat eb̃is len naim nab̃onb̃onan seJu gail, ep̃usan.
Nǝvanuan lup̃aŋ len nap̃usanan san bathut ep̃usan sum̃an naulum̃an tokad na-il-a-m̃o-an kitin, sasum̃an ahai p̃usan gail hǝn nalo.
Len namityal enan ŋai len naim nab̃onb̃onan salito ikad naulum̃an tokad nanunun nǝmargobut. Ikai,
ike, “Yesu ta Nasaret, gumab hǝn ginamito? Gogǝm hǝn gǝb̃igol namteb̃uer a? Ginau nolǝboi gaiug. Nolǝboi gotovi siGot, gotogǝm m̃osi.”
AYesu esivoh len nanunun nǝmargobut, ike, “Gemǝdau! Gimakuv dani!”
Ale nanunun nǝmargobut igol atenan totaltaloŋ hǝn nahumatmat, ikai habat ale nanunun nǝmargobut imakuv dani.

Nǝvanuan gail lumaŋmaŋ lan, lotub̃at sor husur nǝsa tovisi. Lousus galit gabag ke, “Nap̃usanan veveu tomabe ganan? Ikad nǝdaŋan hǝn na-il-a-m̃o-an! Ikele hǝn nanunun tosa gail ale lugol husur nǝsa tokele!”
Na-kel-uri-an husur nǝsa aYesu togole iperŋan tutut hǝn naut p̃isi len naut a Kalili.
AYesu igol nǝvanuan isob̃ur lumaur
Nǝboŋ aYesu mai ahai susur san gail lotovivile dan naim nab̃onb̃onan seJu gail, lutah mai aJemes, aJon, lovi lohoim seSimon mai aAdru.
Anan asoan aSimon ipat len nǝmel, namǝsahan igol niben topud. AYesu tob̃is, vǝha-sua ŋai lusor husur aliten maii.
Ale aYesu ivan hǝni, etǝgau navǝlan, elivi vi mǝhat hǝn b̃ebǝtah. Namǝsahan inoŋ dani ale ile mǝhat, ilav nǝhanian mai galito.
Nǝboŋ namityal tomasur, naut togomgom, nǝvanuan gail losǝhar alat lotomǝsah mai alat lotokad natǝmat gail van hǝn aYesu.
Nǝvanuan p̃isi len nab̃iltivile kavkav loluṽoh il bopita.
Ale igol isob̃ur lotokad namǝsahan tiltile lumaur. Ehut natǝmat isob̃ur ale igol lodǝdas lǝb̃isor husur lolǝboi gai tia.
AYesu ikel ur nasoruan siGot len naut a Kalili
Pelan han, dudulan som̃ilan, naut sǝlan sal, aYesu ile mǝhat, evivile, evi tut sua len naut tob̃ǝb̃esw ale isor tuṽ ei.
Idareh aSimon mai alat lototah maii, ludoŋi.
Nǝboŋ lotosab̃i luke, “Nǝvanuan p̃isi lokǝtkǝta doŋ gaiug.”
Be aYesu isor var galit ke, “Datevi tut ideh am, len naut gail lotodar vis navile egai hǝn nǝb̃ikel ur nasoruan siGot ei. Husur nogǝm m̃osi.”
Ŋa iyar tur p̃is naut len naut a Kalili, ikel ur nasoruan siGot len naim nab̃onb̃onan salito ale ehut natǝmat gail.
AYesu igol avan sua tokad naleprosi imaur
Naulum̃an tokad naleprosi egǝm tǝŋedur tǝban aYesu, eŋiri ke, “Gǝb̃elǝŋoni, golǝboi gǝb̃igol nǝb̃imaur, nǝb̃iveveu.”
Nǝlon aYesu itaŋis masuṽ hǝni, isar hǝn navǝlan, ibari, ikel maii ke, “Nolǝŋoni. Gimaur, giveveu!”
Vǝha-sua ŋai naleprosi ivan dan atenan, imaur, iveveu.
Beti aYesu esǝvati van, ikai tasi

ke, “Sagikel natideh mai avan ideh, be gia ṽusan gaiug hǝn ahai tutumav hǝn b̃ebunus husur nibem̃. Beti getutumav hǝn naviolan hǝn naveveuan sam̃ aMoses tokel bun gail hǝn nǝvanuan lǝb̃elǝboi sǝhoti ke gotomaur.”

Avil ategaii ivan, ikel ur nǝsa tovisi hǝni. Igole van van na-kel-uri-an enan ibar naut isob̃ur. Naten igol aYesu salǝboi b̃eb̃is len navile ideh len nǝhon nǝvanuan gail bathut naluṽoh ludar visi, be itoh len naut gail lotob̃ǝb̃esw. Be nǝvanuan gail len naut p̃isi ei logǝmgǝm hǝni sal.

footnotes.text: 1.1 Natosian galevis ta sutuai lǝsake aNatun aGot.
1.6 2Ki 1.8. Nalokust ehum natohtohlomǝtu be ihan natideh tomaur tokad nalute.
1.7 Evi slev gail lotosah rub̃at nǝhau hǝn naributbut silat lotovi lohoim, ale naslev evi naut kǝmas len nǝnauan salit gail.
1.10 Nǝtav evi nǝman namǝsav sua tohum navimal topǝhapǝhw.

1.14 Lutah gat aJon Baptais nasihau esua hudhute husur nǝboŋ aSetan totaltal ris aYesu hǝn b̃igol b̃isa. AHerot Antipas eriŋ aJon len naim bǝbaŋis husur aJon tokel tabtab hǝn aHerot ke togol nǝsaan. Ris Mak 6.14-29.
